items.statement: Expects company-wide volume growth of about 10% for FY27 despite Q1 de-growth
items.quote: Nevertheless, encouraged by the second quarter's performance, we expect company-wide volume growth of about 10% for FY27, despite the big de-growth during first quarter.

items.statement: Expects piping business volume growth of 13% for FY27
items.quote: We have given volume growth of 13% in the piping business.

items.statement: Expects FY27 revenue between INR13,500 crores to INR14,000 crores and operating margin between 14% to 14.5%
items.quote: FY27, we expect our business to grow between INR13,500 crores to INR14,000 crores, operating margin between 14% to 14.5%.

items.statement: Reaffirms full-year operating margin guidance of 14% to 14.5%
items.quote: We've still given the margin guidance for the full year at 14% to 14.5%. We are very comfortable at 14%, 14.5% we get a very good return on our investment.

items.statement: FY27 capex cash outflow expected at INR700-750 crores
items.quote: Outflow should not be more than INR700 crores to INR750 crores.

items.statement: New units at Bihar, Jammu, Erode, Puducherry and Malanpur plus brownfield expansions progressing as planned
items.quote: Work on new units at Bihar, Jammu, Erode, Puducherry and Malanpur, along with brownfield expansion at various sites is progressing as planned.

items.statement: October plastic piping volume growth at 23% year-on-year
items.quote: Up to yesterday, this month, the growth is 23% in plastic pipe system.

items.statement: Plastic piping volume grew 24% in Q2 FY27, first-half volume growth about 2% year-on-year
items.quote: In Plastic Piping Systems, volume grew about 24% in the second quarter, bringing first-half volume growth to about 2% year on year.

items.statement: Industry PVC demand declined 10% in first half per raw material producers
items.quote: Industry growth, the number what we got from the raw material producer is minus 10%.

items.statement: Packaging segment margins hit by steep polythene price increases linked to crude and Middle East supply constraints
items.quote: Elevated prices are difficult to pass on. The increase were too steep in the polythene price, because it is directly linked to crude price, then cheap supply was not able to come from Middle East.

items.statement: Price increases passed on after 10-15 day lag to help distributors repair balance sheets
items.quote: We increase the price. We increase the effect in the market after 10 to 15 days.

items.statement: Announced CPVC price hikes of 3%, 5%, 7% product-to-product effective tomorrow
items.quote: Some 3%, 5%, 7% product to product. We are announcing increase in price from tomorrow.

items.statement: Value-added products turnover grew 38% to Rs.1476 crores in Q2 FY27
items.quote: The overall turnover of value -added products increased to Rs. 1476 crores during the current 2 nd quarter as compared to Rs. 1072 crores in the corresponding quarter of previous year, achieving growth of 38

items.statement: O-PVC, windows & doors, bath fittings (MOHO), gas fittings seeing strong growth and acceptance
items.quote: I can say O -PVC business picking up now. We anticipate good growth for the full year in O - PVC. We are introducing several new varieties also in O -PVC going forward in the remaining six months. On window, our business in window is increasing. Every month we are servicing with distributors in the major cities, and we are quite optimistic in the growth of window business. We are also very encoura

items.statement: Minimum Import Price on suspension-grade PVC resin and withdrawal of customs duty exemption helped reduce volatility
items.quote: Geopolitical developments in West Asia remain a source of uncertainty, while the Minimum Import Price on suspension-grade PVC resin and withdrawal of the customs duty exemption have helped reduce volatility.

items.statement: Inventory gain expected for the year; channel inventories kept at minimum levels
items.quote: There will be some inventory gain. We anticipate as to there will be inventory gain in this year.

items.statement: Investments funded through healthy cash flows and internal accruals while maintaining financial discipline
items.quote: We will continue to fund these investments through healthy cash flows and internal accruals while maintaining financial discipline.

items.statement: Employee cost up 25% YoY in H1 due to 9% increments, new hires, and new units; H1 FY27 at INR330 crores vs INR580 crores full year prior
items.quote: For the first half, it is INR330 crores. Akash Shah: P. C. Somani: As compared to INR580 crores last year. Since no new Greenfield is coming this year, our first half number is the benchmark for the second half also, except the commission to directors, which is based on the profits of the company

items.statement: Nal Se Jal business not expected to expand significantly this year due to state funding constraints
items.quote: Nal Se Jal this year as on today, I can say it is going to be much lower than what was the budget. When the state government is not matching fund, the central government will not be money coming. We are not very optimistic of any big volume business in Nal Se Jal this year also.

items.statement: Consumer products degrew 14% in volume due to high polypropylene prices and government diversion of capacity to LPG production
items.quote: Price has gone too high. The material was not available also because government had put restriction on the local producer. They diverted quite a good capacity to make LPG. From polypropylene, you were asked to do even 50% LPG and 50% only to make raw mater ial. The local supply also was affected due to less availability of polypropylene
